text: Operational intervention during research iteration 2: the driver interrupted and resumed the same assigned worker after two unanswered status requests and a source-image retrieval that the worker reported had stalled for 647 seconds. The worker retained completed acquisitions and reported no tracked edits before interruption. The driver requested bounded retrieval timeouts, reconciliation of outstanding operations, and completion of the unchanged compiled repair packet. No finding, source requirement, reviewer verdict or workflow transition was altered.
